cards.name: Deoxys Normal Forme
cards.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.description: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.description: It is so timid, it can't move if it isn't with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.

cards.name: Lileep
cards.description: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.description: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon always keeps its face pointing north.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.description: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.description: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.description: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.description: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.description: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units call Mini-Noses.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

cards.name: Armaldo
cards.description: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.description: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

cards.name: Cradily
cards.description: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.description: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Deoxys Attack Forme
cards.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys Defense Forme

cards.name: Deoxys Speed Forme
cards.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.description: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.description: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.description: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.description: With extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

cards.name: Regice
cards.description: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.description: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.description: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.description: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.description: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Unown !
cards.description: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

cards.name: Anorith
cards.description: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.description: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

cards.name: Castform
cards.description: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

cards.name: Castform Rain Form

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.description: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

cards.name: Metang

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.description: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.description: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

cards.name: Swalot
cards.description: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.description: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dive steeply to catch the prey.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.

cards.description: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

cards.name: Chinchou

cards.name: Corphish
cards.description: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.description: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey's face.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.description: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
